title: Capital Territory Local Government Amendment Act 1988

sections.shortTitle: Capital Territory Local Government Amendment Act 1988
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1988
CAPITAL TERRITORY
LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1988
ACT IV OF 1988
An Act further to amend the Capital
Territory Local
Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 29th May, 1988]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 10th May, 1988, and are hereby published for
general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Capital Territory Local
Government (Amendment) Act, 1988.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Capital Territory Local Government Amendment Act 1988
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 101, Ordinance XXXIX of 1979

ACT IV OF 1988
CAPITAL TERRITORY
LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1988
ACT IV OF 1988
An Act further to amend the Capital
Territory Local
Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 29th May, 1988]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 10th May, 1988, and are hereby published for
general information:--
2. Amendment of Section 101,
Ordinance XXXIX of 1979.-----In the Capital Territory Local Government
Ordinance, 1979 (XXXIX of 1979), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance,
in section 101, after subsection (1), the following new subsection shall be
inserted, namely:--
"(1-A) An order in appeal
shall not be passed without affording to the appellant an opportunity of being
heard.".
